title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a tangent-slope readout to the Session 1 position graph
body:
## Problem
The position graph draws a tangent line but the numeric slope is only in the readout; some students miss the link.

## Context
The key idea of Session 1 is that the slope of x-t is the velocity.

## Expected outcome
A label on the tangent line that shows the slope with its unit, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The label updates with the sliders
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: choose the smoothing window automatically
body:
## Problem
Session 3 asks the learner to choose the smoothing window by hand.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask how to choose a window when the exact motion is not known.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3, using cross-validation.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a recording from your own phone
body:
## Problem
The mini-project uses a synthetic dataset; students want a real recording.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5. A rolling trolley filmed at 30 frames per second is enough.

## Expected outcome
A lesson that loads a CSV of times and positions from a real video, plus a short guide on how to record and read the positions.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A real dataset (CC BY 4.0) with a README on how it was recorded
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: velocity and acceleration with small errors
body:
## Problem
The Target animation recovers velocity and acceleration from noisy positions with small errors; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Acceleration RMS error below 0.1 m/s^2 for a smooth trip with 3 cm noise at 20 samples per second
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
